Alyssa / Soojin — thanks for the note and the redlines. From Legal's perspective: we are willing to provide evidence and reasonable audit cooperation, but we need to limit scope and protect other customers' data and Redwood's proprietary artefacts. Proposed positions below: 

- Audit mechanism: accept remote evidence review by NovaClin or an independent third-party auditor engaged by NovaClin, provided Redwood can redact or exclude any customer-specific data and sensitive materials. We are not amenable to unrestricted on-site access.
- Notice & scheduling: 30 days' notice, maximum 2 audits per 12-month period, with mutually agreed scope.
- Evidence types: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II executive summary (non-authorized copy) and an executive summary of the most recent external penetration test (redacted). Full SOC 2 reports will be shared under NDA / limited distribution agreement only.
- Tooling: we accept AdobeSign or DocuSign for execution. We will provide an envelope link once countersigned.

Attachments I'm sharing for NovaClin's review: Redwood_SOC2_2026_ExecSummary.pdf, pen_test_exec_summary_2026.pdf. The SOC 2 exec summary contains control coverage, audit period, and remediation notes; it should satisfy most procurement questionnaires.

If NovaClin still requires on-site walkthroughs or full SOC 2 disclosure, we can discuss a tighter scoped addendum and an NDA for privileged access, but that will take longer than this week.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Karthik / Soojin — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the executive summaries. The exec summaries look good and should be sufficient for our security review in the short term. A couple of clarifications/requests: 

- Remote evidence review is acceptable; NovaClin prefers a contractor-led review (third-party) with the scope limited to controls that touch NovaClin customer data and REDWOOD's control environment relevant to data handling.
- We can accept the 30-day notice and 2 audits per year limitation.
- For our procurement compliance, we'll need a signed DPA. AdobeSign is preferred internally (we have an existing integration). If Redwood can send an AdobeSign envelope, procurement will push to finalize today.

I will have our procurement team expect an envelope — please mark the envelope subject as "DPA - NovaClin / Redwood". Once executed, we will confirm counterparty contact for annual audit requests.
